hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && PATH="$HOME/.local/node20/bin:$PATH" npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
if grep -q 'docker compose up'; then [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.env" ] || echo '[WARN] .env manquant — copier .env.example en .env avant de lancer Docker Compose'; fi
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo '=== Git status ===' && git status --short && echo '=== Fichiers non commités ===' && git diff --stat HEAD 2>/dev/null | tail -5
